title: Reinstatement Basis by Removal Stage and Timing — Design Studio Selections
content:
**Pricing rule.** The reinstatement basis of a removed Design Studio Selections option line is set by when the line was removed and how long ago:

- a line removed after construction started (its removal entry shows the stage foundation, framing, drywall or finishes) and put back within 30 days of its removal is reinstated at the removal credit booked for it;
- a line removed after construction started and put back more than 30 days after its removal is reinstated at that removal credit plus 50 percent of the part of its price Calloway retained;
- a line removed before construction started is reinstated at the price at which it had been selected.

**Terms.** *Within 30 days* means 30 calendar days or fewer from the date on the removal entry to the day the line is put back. *The part of its price Calloway retained* is the price at which the line had been selected less the removal credit booked for it.

**Cases on hypothetical figures** (line selected at 4000.00; removed at framing with a removal credit of 2000.00)

| Put back | Basis |
|---|---|
| 30 days after removal | 2000.00 |
| 31 days after removal | 2000.00 plus 50 percent of 2000.00: 3000.00 |
| Same line, had it been removed before construction started | 4000.00 |
